admission.justification: The root/route templates and authoring instruction must agree or the first attributed tree silently contains legacy cards.

applicability: Initial root, route and file onboarding produced by the bootstrap skill in converted memory.
conditions: Currentness is carried by resolved reference anchors.
Authors write prose and temporary citation tables; the existing fixer allocates numbered references and authors sidecars.
exclusions: Metadata stamps, card Update History and hand-authored sidecar JSON.
Input ledgers or report templates that legitimately use tables but are not onboarding cards.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_bootstrap_converted_onboarding.py::test_bootstrap_skill_texts_carry_no_legacy_card_format; mcp/tests/test_sync_scripts.py (72 generated copies byte-equal); evidence/run-new-module.txt (18 passed)

statement: Bootstrap onboarding cards are written in the converted shape: no metadata table, no Update History, citation tables as fixer input, currentness from reference anchors.
